adapter_contract.fixture: Provide each declared state fixture; load the initial_state fixture before dispatch.
adapter_contract.keyboard: Dispatch the key with modifiers, then assert every field in the case's assert mapping.
adapter_contract.accessibility: Capture the actual platform accessibility tree and compare declared semantics.
adapter_contract.screenshots: Render each state/theme/scale case and compare its named baseline.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Zoom in by 25 percent around the visible-range center.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Zoom out by 25 percent around the visible-range center.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Pan earlier by ten percent of the visible duration.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Pan later by ten percent of the visible duration.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has focus and at least one valid clip exists.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Fit the full clip extent with five percent padding on each side.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Step the playhead earlier by 0.1 seconds, clamped to the visible range.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Step the playhead later by 0.1 seconds, clamped to the visible range.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus and objects exist.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Select the previous object in track order then clip time/id order.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The labeled timeline group has keyboard focus and objects exist.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Select the next object in track order then clip time/id order.

keyboard_cases.precondition: A clip or keyframe move is active.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Commit the edit and emit its typed move request when changed.

keyboard_cases.precondition: A clip or keyframe move is active.

keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Nudge the selected clip or keyframe later by one ruler tick step.

keyboard_cases.precondition: The timeline has focus and keyframes exist.
keyboard_cases.expected_behavior: Select the next keyframe in time/id order.
